name: Bottle Post
summary: A seaside 404 page: a ship-in-a-bottle washes ashore, pops its cork and unrolls the page as a message
about: A full not-found page for a coastal travel journal, set on a Makran beach at golden hour or under a moonlit, glowing sea. A bottle with a tiny ship inside drifts onto the sand, the cork pops and the rolled message flies out and unrolls into the page itself, with a working search and ports of call. Pick a result and the reply is written in by hand, a wax seal stamps down and the little ship hoists its sails.
how: The bottle drifts in on the waves, the cork pops and the message unrolls by itself
Type where you were headed in Where should the tide take you? and pick a result with the mouse or the arrow keys
The reply is written in, the wax seal stamps and the ship in the bottle raises its sails
Click the sea or press Skim a stone to count your skips; four skips earns a wink
Press the bottle to cork it and pop it again, or poke the crab for a quip
It plays a short demo by itself until you click or type
